content:
maya: saw weird rows from another org in Console analytics panel when switching tabs quickly. repro steps: open org 812 -> open insights -> cmd+tab to org 909 -> back to 812 and rows for 909 show up.
liam: can reproduce 3/5 tries. looks like a racing prefetch + tab-stickiness issue.
maya: i captured network trace and there are two background fetches arriving with different tenant headers but same session id.
jun-sre: pls paste the trace snippet.
liam: snippet: `req_id=xyz111 fetch=background session=ses-42 X-Org=812 X-Tab-Prefetch-Org=909`
alejandra: X-Tab-Prefetch-Org? that's a new header from the console prefetcher we rolled last month for perf. it's supposed to be advisory only.
ben: if it's advisory but edge treats it as authoritative while routing cached responses, that's a problem. Could be cache-key collision between prefetch and on-demand fetch.
maya: i think prefetch writes a small cached response keyed by session-id -> last-prefetch-org. then the on-demand fetch reads session cache without verifying request's explicit org header.
jun-sre: immediate mitigation: toggle the 'tab-prefetch' feature flag OFF for prod and canary, and add a quick guard in edge to drop cached hits when explicit X-Org header present and mismatches.
deploy-bot: feature-flag 'console-tab-prefetch' set to OFF in prod-canary at 2026-02-20T09:11:00Z.
alejandra: longer term we should make cache key include request-scoped tenant (x-org) and tab-id. Tab-id is available as X-Tab-Id in the client.
liam: also debating whether edge should reject mismatched prefetched responses (409) or just ignore cached entry and fetch fresh (200 but slower). thoughts?\unjun-sre: (jun-sre): prefer fail-open for user-perceived latency: ignore cache when mismatch and emit high-sev metric + alert. avoid returning 4xx for users if they're properly authenticated.
ben: finance concern: we've observed quota attribution jumps for org 909 when maya was on 812. need to audit how billing counts were attributed. possible double counting.
maya: yep, saw spike in request_count for 909 in the last 30m. attaching HAR to the internal ticket.
liam: proposed middleware pseudo: ```if (cache.hit && cache.meta.prefetch_org && cache.meta.prefetch_org !== req.headers['x-org']) { metric.inc('prefetch.tenant_mismatch'); cache.invalidate(); proceed_to_origin(); }```
alejandra: + add a 1-week sample of these metrics to evaluate exposure. also add a log line with req_id, session, tab_id (redact user email).
\unjun-sre: we should also create a console UX indicator so product sees when data might be stale/mismatched (small banner: "Data may be from a different org while we sync").
\maya: good for transparency. CS asked to be notified so we can proactively contact affected customers if billing impacted.
ben: i'll coordinate with CS and finance. if bill delta > $100 for a customer we'll reach out.
liam: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/edge/pull/4345 implementing ignore-on-mismatch + metric. unit tests included.
alejandra: i'll follow with cache-key change PR and client patch to include X-Tab-Id in prefetch calls.
jun-sre: action list: 1) flag off prefetch (done canary) 2) land middleware ignore-on-mismatch (liam) 3) update cache keys & client tab id (alejandra) 4) run billing backfill and checkpoint (ben) 5) add console banner & UX telemetry (maya) 6) postmortem and brief for product and CS (maya/jun-sre).
maya: putting HAR + short vid in the ticket.
liam: also added a short stress script to repro fast org flips: https://internal/redwood/scripts/prefetch-repro.sh
ben: thanks. i'll surface to finance and tag any customers with anomalous spikes.
deploy-bot: deployed edge PR #4345 to prod-canary at 2026-02-20T10:02:15Z.
\unjun-sre: follow-up: set alert if prefetched_mismatch_rate > 0 for 10m in prod, and create a dashboard tile for weekly trend.
alejandra: will update the prefetch docs to call out tenant scoping and tab-id requirement.
maya: thanks all. please ping here when PRs are live so i can validate with the HAR. :thumbsup:
